comparison.objective: Extract one decommissioned cable from a clipped live bundle; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective deformable extraction through clips versus granular screening through fixed apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Blue cable removed while grey cables remain clipped versus ≥98% media recovery and zero washer loss.
comparison.reason: Selective cable routing does not test physical particle-size separation.
